verdict.rationale: Runpod provides standard, open mechanisms to pull data out — an S3-compatible API for network volumes, SSH access to Pods, and a CLI (runpodctl) for transferring files between local machines and Runpod — none of which lock data into proprietary formats. However, there is no explicit 'export all your account data' feature or documentation addressing full data portability (e.g., configs, logs, billing history) for account closure. missing for 10: explicit full-account data export/closure workflow, independent confirmation that S3/CLI export covers all stored data types (models, logs, metadata), not just network volume files.
